shadows.purpose: Flat paper-backed depth for planning evidence.

motion.name: route-dash
motion.purpose: Slow route movement on the map board.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-entry reveal, disabled with reduced motion.

components.name: Departure Button
components.css: .ds-depart { background:#d9ee36; color:#10263c; border:0; border-radius:18px; padding:0 18px; height:52px; font:700 14px Arial,sans-serif; transition:transform .25s ease,background .25s ease; } .ds-depart:hover { background:#cce333; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-depart:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #264f75; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Trip Input
components.description: A traveler begins with one plain sentence.
components.html: <label class="ds-trip">Where would you like to go?<input placeholder="7 days in Pakistan for two" /></label>
components.css: .ds-trip { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#10263c; font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-trip input { height:70px; background:#fffdf8; border:1px solid #a7afae; border-radius:24px; padding:0 18px; color:#10263c; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-trip input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #264f75; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Sign-in Pill
components.css: .ds-signin { background:transparent; color:#10263c; border:1px solid #aab5bb; border-radius:999px; padding:10px 18px; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; transition:background .25s ease,color .25s ease; } .ds-signin:hover { background:#10263c; color:#fff; } .ds-signin:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #264f75; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: TripForge uses a light wayfinding system to make coordinated travel planning feel physical, inspectable, and calm.

rules.name: The Departure Signal Rule
rules.body: Citron is a stateful signal, not general decoration.

donts: Don't represent synthetic planning information as real availability.
